pnpm.overrides-comment: The markdown language asks for the HTML grammar in a static import, and that grammar brings the CSS and JavaScript ones with it: a hundred and forty kilobytes in front of the first paint for the notes that have a tag in them. What it gets instead fetches the real grammar when a note turns out to have one - see packages/lang-html, which is the whole of the reasoning. Scoped to that one package, so a ```html fence and the editor's own door still reach the real thing.
